57	  attach(weather: WeatherState, hooks: WeatherFxHooks) {
58	    this.weather = weather;
59	    this.hooks = hooks;
60	  }
61	  detach() { this.weather = null; this.hooks = null; this.pool.length = 0; }
62	
63	  /** 池容量 = 屏宽比例（原版 Main.maxRain 语义近似：屏宽/视口宽×25） */
64	  private ensurePool(cap: number) {
65	    this.poolCap = cap;
66	    while (this.pool.length < cap) {
67	      this.pool.push({ x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, scale: 1, rotation: 0, type: 0, active: false });
68	    }
69	  }
70	
71	  /** Rain.MakeRain（Rain.cs:21-77）：每帧按 cloudAlpha 掷新滴 */
72	  private makeRain(viewW: number, camX: number, camY: number, playerVx: number, playerVy: number, world: World) {
73	    const w = this.weather;
74	    const hooks = this.hooks;
75	    if (!w || !hooks || w.cloudAlpha <= 0 || hooks.atmo < 0.4) return;
76	    let num = (viewW / 1920) * 25;               // MaxWorldViewSize.X≈1920 的比例
77	    num *= 0.25 + 1 * w.cloudAlpha;              // Rain.cs:28
78	    if (hooks.bossDanger) num = Math.max(1, num * 0.05);
79	    for (let i = 0; i < num; i++) {
80	      // 屏外缓冲 ±600（玩家上跳 ×30，Rain.cs:44-48）
81	      let margin = 600;
82	      if (playerVy < 0) margin += Math.floor(Math.abs(playerVy) * 30);
83	      let x = camX - margin + Math.random() * (viewW + margin * 2);
84	      const y = camY - (20 + Math.random() * 80);
85	      x -= w.windSpeedCurrent * 15 * 40;          // 风偏移（Rain.cs:51）
86	      x += playerVx * 40;                          // 玩家运动补偿
87	      x = Math.max(0, Math.min((world.w - 1) * TILE, x));
88	      const tx = Math.max(0, Math.min(world.w - 1, Math.floor(x / TILE)));
89	      const ty = Math.max(0, Math.min(world.h - 1, Math.floor(y / TILE)));
90	      // 起点须非实心且无墙（Rain.cs:72-74）
91	      const st = world.store;
92	      const solid = st.isSolid(tx, ty);
93	      const wall = st.wall[st.idx(tx, ty)];
94	      if (solid || wall > 0) continue;
95	      this.spawnRain(x, y);
96	    }
97	  }
98	
99	  /** Rain.NewRain（Rain.cs:159-209）：atmo^9 削减 + 雪区平方削减 + 池按 cloudAlpha 限量 */
100	  private spawnRain(x: number, y: number) {
101	    const w = this.weather!;
102	    const hooks = this.hooks!;
103	    let cap = Math.floor(this.poolCap * w.cloudAlpha);
104	    const snow = hooks.snowRatio * hooks.snowRatio;
105	    cap = Math.floor(cap * (1 - snow));
106	    cap = Math.floor(cap * Math.pow(hooks.atmo, 9));
107	    if (cap <= 0) return;
108	    let slot = -1;
109	    for (let i = 0; i < cap; i++) {
110	      if (!this.pool[i].active) { slot = i; break; }
111	    }
112	    if (slot < 0) return;
113	    const d = this.pool[slot];
114	    d.active = true;
115	    d.x = x; d.y = y;
116	    d.scale = 1 + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) - 20) * 0.01;
117	    d.vx = w.windSpeedCurrent * 18 * d.scale;
118	    d.vy = 14 * d.scale;
119	    d.rotation = Math.atan2(d.vx, -d.vy);
120	    d.type = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);       // waterStyle=0 → type 0-2（Rain.png 三型）
121	  }
122	
123	  /** 每帧：雨滴更新 + 沙尘发射（在绘制前的逻辑阶段调用，或 draw 内合并——原版即 draw 时 update） */
124	  update(world: World, viewW: number, camX: number, camY: number, playerVx: number, playerVy: number) {
125	    if (!this.weather) return;
126	    this.ensurePool(Math.min(2400, Math.max(600, Math.floor(viewW * 1.2))));
127	    const hooks = this.hooks;
128	    if (!hooks) return;
129	    this.makeRain(viewW, camX, camY, playerVx, playerVy, world);
130	    const camBottom = camY + 2000;
131	    const st = world.store;
132	    for (const d of this.pool) {
133	      if (!d.active) continue;
134	      d.x += d.vx;
135	      d.y += d.vy;
136	      const tx = Math.floor((d.x + 1) / TILE);
137	      const ty = Math.floor((d.y + 1) / TILE);
138	      const solid = st.inBounds(tx, ty) && st.isSolid(tx, ty);
139	      const wet = st.inBounds(tx, ty) && st.liquid[st.idx(tx, ty)] > 0;
140	      if (solid || wet || d.y > camBottom) {
141	        d.active = false;
142	        // 落水花（Rain.cs:120-133 概率近似）
143	        if (Math.random() < 0.5 && hooks.atmo > 0.5) {
144	          hooks.emitSand(d.x, d.y, -d.vx * 0.025, -d.vy * 0.025 - 2, '#B8D0E8');
145	        }
146	      }
147	    }
148	    this.emitSandstorm(world, viewW, camX, camY);
149	  }
150	
151	  /** Sandstorm.EmitDust（Sandstorm.cs:141-248）近似：风向速度 + 四色加权 + Severity 密度 */
152	  private emitSandstorm(world: World, viewW: number, camX: number, camY: number) {
153	    const w = this.weather!;
154	    const hooks = this.hooks!;
155	    const sand = w.sandstorm;
156	    if (!hooks.sandstormVisuals || !sand.happening || hooks.desertSandTiles < 100) return;
157	    const dir = Math.sign(w.windSpeedCurrent);
158	    const windAbs = Math.abs(w.windSpeedCurrent);
159	    if (windAbs < 0.01) return;
160	    const vxBase = dir * (0.9 + windAbs * 0.1);
161	    // 密度：20×Severity×(屏宽比例) 上限（num8 L171：1000×屏宽比×质量系数）
162	    const n = Math.round(20 * sand.severity * (viewW / 1920 + 0.5));
163	    const colors = hooks.sandColors().filter((c) => c.weight > 0);
164	    const totalW = colors.reduce((s, c) => s + c.weight, 0);
165	    if (!colors.length || totalW <= 0) return;
166	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
167	      let x = camX - 500 + Math.random() * (viewW + 1000);
168	      let y = camY - 50 + Math.random() * (600 + Math.random() * 400);
169	      if (x < camX || x > camX + viewW) y += Math.random() * 400;
170	      const tx = Math.floor(x / TILE);
171	      const ty = Math.floor(y / TILE);
172	      if (!stIn(world, tx, ty) || world.store.wall[world.store.idx(tx, ty)] !== 0) continue;
173	      let pick = Math.random() * totalW;
174	      let color = colors[0].color;
175	      for (const c of colors) { pick -= c.weight; if (pick <= 0) { color = c.color; break; } }
176	      hooks.emitSand(x, y,
177	        vxBase * 5 * (0.5 + sand.severity * 0.3) + dir * (Math.random() * 2),
178	        2 + Math.random() * 0.2, color);
179	    }
180	  }
181	
182	  /** Rain.Draw（Main.cs:38238-38266）：2×40 条 × type 偏移，光照着色 ×0.85 */
183	  draw(r: Renderer, world: World) {
184	    const w = this.weather;
185	    const hooks = this.hooks;
186	    if (!w || !hooks || w.cloudAlpha <= 0) return;
187	    const ctx = r.ctx;
188	    const tex = getRainTex();
189	    const texOk = tex && tex.complete && tex.naturalWidth > 0;
190	    ctx.save();
191	    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
192	    for (const d of this.pool) {
193	      if (!d.active) continue;
194	      const tx = Math.floor((d.x + 4) / TILE);
195	      const ty = Math.floor((d.y + 4) / TILE);
196	      const [lr, lg, lb] = hooks.lightAt(tx, ty);
197	      ctx.save();
198	      ctx.translate(d.x + 1, d.y);
199	      ctx.rotate(d.rotation);
200	      if (texOk) {
201	        // 光照着色（原版 GetColor×0.85）：量化 8 级 × 3 型预烘焙乘色条（multiply+destination-in），
202	        // 每滴一次 drawImage——精确到 1/8 亮度量化，替代旧黑罩近似
203	        const lvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(((lr + lg + lb) / (3 * 255)) * 8)));
204	        const v = Math.round((lvl / 7) * 0.85 * 255);
205	        const tinted = tintedRainStrip(tex!, d.type, v);
206	        if (tinted) {
207	          ctx.drawImage(tinted, 0, 0, 2, 40, 0, -20 * d.scale, 2 * d.scale, 40 * d.scale);
208	        }
209	      }
210	      ctx.restore();
211	    }
212	    ctx.restore();
213	    void world;
214	  }
215	}
216	
217	/** 乘色雨滴条缓存（type×8 级亮度）：multiply 灰阶 ×0.85 上限 + destination-in 保形 */
218	const rainTintCache = new Map<string, HTMLCanvasElement>();
219	function tintedRainStrip(tex: HTMLImageElement, type: number, v: number): HTMLCanvasElement | null {
220	  const key = `${type}|${v}`;
221	  const hit = rainTintCache.get(key);
222	  if (hit) return hit;
223	  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
224	  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
225	  c.width = 2; c.height = 40;
226	  const cx = c.getContext('2d')!;
227	  cx.drawImage(tex, type * 4, 0, 2, 40, 0, 0, 2, 40);
228	  cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
229	  cx.fillStyle = `rgb(${v},${v},${v})`;
230	  cx.fillRect(0, 0, 2, 40);
231	  cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
232	  cx.drawImage(tex, type * 4, 0, 2, 40, 0, 0, 2, 40);
233	  rainTintCache.set(key, c);
234	  return c;
235	}
236	
237	function stIn(world: World, tx: number, ty: number): boolean {
238	  return world.store.inBounds(tx, ty);
239	}

export class MoonLeechProj extends Entity {

    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    this.vx = (dx / d) * 6; this.vy = (dy / d) * 6;   // :37823 出速 6（AI 段接管为 16 上限）
  }

  fixedUpdate(_dt: number, game: GameHooks): void {
    const src = (game.enemies() as Enemy[]).find((n) => n.id === this.srcId);
    const player = game.player;
    if (--this.life <= 0 || !src || src.dead) { this.dead = true; return; }
    if (!player || player.dead) { if (this.out) this.out = false; }   // :30706-30712 玩家失联即回程
    this.age++;

    const tx = this.out ? player.cx : src.cx;
    const ty = this.out ? player.cy : src.cy + 216;
    const dx = tx - this.cx, dy = ty - this.cy;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const spd = Math.min(16, d);
    if (d > 0.001) { this.vx = (dx / d) * spd; this.vy = (dy / d) * spd; }
    this.x += this.vx; this.y += this.vy;
    // 贴身结算：出击段 <20px 授 MoonLeech 145（:30726-30732）；回程段 <20px Kill（:30740-30743）
    if (this.out && d < 20 && !this.fed) {

      player.buffs.apply(BuffType.MoonLeech, 840 / 60);
    } else if (!this.out && d < 20) {
      this.dead = true;
    }
  }

  draw(r: Renderer, _cam: Camera): void {

    // 自旋（:30717）：(源心 - 玩家心 + (0,216)) 角 + π/2——回程矢量已同向，直接用速度角近似
    const ang = Math.atan2(this.vy, this.vx) + Math.PI / 2;

  }

```ts
export interface RareCloudFlags { downedBoss1, downedBoss2, downedBoss3, hardMode, crimson, dontStarveWorld, tenthAnniversaryWorld }
export function rollRareCloud(f: RareCloudFlags, rnd: () => number): number {
  let num = -1, ok = false;
  let guard = 0;
  while (!ok && guard++ < 10000) {
    num = Math.floor(rnd() * (f.tenthAnniversaryWorld ? 15 : 19)) + 22;  // Next(22,41) → 22..40 ; Next(22,37) → 22..36
    switch (num) {
      case 31: ok = f.downedBoss3; break;
      case 36: ok = f.downedBoss2 && f.crimson; break;
      case 25: case 26: ok = f.downedBoss1; break;
      case 30: case 35: ok = f.hardMode; break;
      case 28: ok = Math.floor(rnd() * 10) === 0; break;
      case 37: case 38: case 39: case 40: ok = f.dontStarveWorld || Math.floor(rnd() * 10) === 0; break;
      default: ok = true;
    }
  }
  return num;
}
```

/** 稀有云世界旗标（Cloud.cs RollRareCloud :183-227 的门输入） */
export interface RareCloudFlags {
  /** NPC.downedBoss1（克苏鲁之眼）→ 云 25/26 */
  downedBoss1: boolean;
  /** NPC.downedBoss2（世吞/克脑）+ WorldGen.crimson → 云 36 */
  downedBoss2: boolean;
  /** NPC.downedBoss3（骷髅王）→ 云 31 */
  downedBoss3: boolean;
  /** Main.hardMode → 云 30/35（南瓜王/飞龙云） */
  hardMode: boolean;
  /** WorldGen.crimson */
  crimson: boolean;
  /** Main.dontStarveWorld（饥荒世界云 37-40 直通） */
  dontStarveWorld: boolean;
  /** Main.tenthAnniversaryWorld（十周年云 37-40 不出、稀有云 1/3 直通） */
  tenthAnniversaryWorld: boolean;
}

/** RollRareCloud（Cloud.cs:183-227 1:1）：22-40 内掷点，旗标门未过重掷。 */
export function rollRareCloud(f: RareCloudFlags, rnd: () => number): number {
  let num = -1;
  let ok = false;
  let guard = 0;
  while (!ok && guard++ < 500) {
    num = 22 + Math.floor(rnd() * (f.tenthAnniversaryWorld ? 15 : 19));  // :189 Next(22,41)/(22,37)
    switch (num) {
      case 31: ok = f.downedBoss3; break;                       // :195-197
      case 36: ok = f.downedBoss2 && f.crimson; break;          // :198-200
      case 25: case 26: ok = f.downedBoss1; break;              // :201-204
      case 30: case 35: ok = f.hardMode; break;                 // :205-208
      case 28: ok = Math.floor(rnd() * 10) === 0; break;        // :209-214
      case 37: case 38: case 39: case 40:
        ok = f.dontStarveWorld || Math.floor(rnd() * 10) === 0; break;  // :215-223
      default: ok = true; break;
    }
  }
  return num;
}
```

So magAccX = (0.5+r*0.5) * (r*accRand + accRandBase) * accMul.

Gastropod: vector2 = (r*0.1+0.1, r*0.3+0.3) (NOT 0.5+r*0.5!) — different base. So the acc base differs per family: gastropod (0.1..0.2, 0.3..0.6), others (0.5..1.0, 0.5..1.0). I'll encode accBaseX/accBaseY formulas: {accX: [0.1, 0.1], accY: [0.3, 0.3]} meaning base + r*span.

```ts
export function pickAmbientFamily(i: AmbientSpawnInput): AmbientFamily | null {
  if (i.moonLordActive) return null;   // AnActiveSkyConflictsWithAmbience
  const sunny = !i.raining && i.dayTime && !i.eclipse;
  const calmNight = !i.raining && !i.dayTime && !i.bloodMoon && !i.pumpkinMoon && !i.snowMoon;
  const windy = i.windyDay ?? false;
  const sunset = i.sunset ?? false;
  const z = {
    vulture: i.zoneDesert ?? false, pixieposse: i.zoneHallow, seagulls: i.zoneBeach ?? false,
    gastropod: i.zoneHallow, pegasus: i.zoneHallow, eos: i.zoneCorrupt ?? false,
    crimera: i.zoneCrimson ?? false, bats: i.zoneJungle ?? false,
  };
  const conds: Array<[AmbientFamily, boolean, boolean | undefined, boolean]> = [
    // [族, cond, secondary, hellHeightOnly]
    ['birds', sunny, undefined, false],

  /** 族贴图键（各族 Texture 请求 1:1；变体族按掷点/深度选） */
  private ambientTexKey(kind: AmbientFamily, r: () => number, depth: number): { key: string; rows: number; variant: number } {
    switch (kind) {
      case 'birds': return { key: 'Ambience_BirdsVShape', rows: 4, variant: 0 };
      case 'wyvern': return { key: 'Ambience_Wyvern', rows: 5, variant: 0 };
      case 'airship': return { key: 'Ambience_FlyingShip', rows: 4, variant: 0 };
      case 'airballoon': { const large = Math.floor(r() * 2) === 0; return { key: large ? 'Ambience_AirBalloons_Large' : 'Ambience_AirBalloons_Small', rows: 5, variant: 0 }; }
      case 'eyeball': return { key: 'Ambience_EOC', rows: 3, variant: 0 };
      case 'butterflies': { const n = Math.floor(r() * 2) + 1; return { key: `Ambience_ButterflySwarm${n}`, rows: n === 2 ? 19 : 17, variant: n }; }
      case 'lostkite': return { key: 'Ambience_LostKite', rows: 42, variant: 0 };
      case 'vulture': return { key: 'Ambience_Vulture', rows: 10, variant: 0 };
      case 'bats': { const n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3); return { key: `Ambience_Bat${n}`, rows: 10, variant: n }; }
      case 'pixieposse': { const n = this.amb.dayTime ? 1 : 2; return { key: `Ambience_PixiePosse${n}`, rows: 25, variant: n }; }
      case 'seagulls': return { key: 'Ambience_Seagull', rows: 9, variant: 0 };
      case 'slimeBalloons': return { key: 'Ambience_SlimeBalloons', rows: 7, variant: 0 };
      case 'gastropod': return { key: 'Ambience_Gastropod', rows: 1, variant: 0 };
      case 'pegasus': return { key: 'Ambience_Pegasus', rows: 11, variant: 0 };
      case 'eos': case 'crimera': {
        let n = 3; if (depth <= 6) n = 2; if (depth <= 5) n = 1;
        return { key: `${kind === 'eos' ? 'Ambience_EOS' : 'Ambience_Crimera'}${n}`, rows: kind === 'eos' ? 4 : 3, variant: n };
      }
      case 'hellbats': { const n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * 2); return { key: `Ambience_HellBat${n}`, rows: 10, variant: n }; }
    }
  }

  private mkAmbient(kind: AmbientFamily, sx: number, sy: number, depth: number, dir: 1 | -1,
    life: number, camX: number, camY: number, texKey: string, rows: number, variant: number): AmbientEnt {

```ts
  private spawnAmbientFamily(kind: AmbientFamily, camX: number, camY: number): void {
    const r = Math.random;
    const spec = AMBIENT_FAMILY_PARAMS[kind];
    const wind = this.weatherRef ? this.weatherRef.windSpeedCurrent : this.wind;
    const windT = this.weatherRef ? this.weatherRef.windSpeedTarget : this.windTarget;
    const group = AMBIENT_GROUP_SPEC[kind];
    const storming = this.weatherRef ? this.weatherRef.shouldUseStormMusic : false;
    // spriteDir（:191 等：WindForVisuals≤0 → Flip；Airship/AirBalloon = random.Next(2)）
    const randomDir = !!spec.randomDir;
    const dir: 1 | -1 = randomDir ? (Math.floor(r() * 2) !== 0 ? -1 : 1) : (wind > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    const halfW = this.ambViewW / 2, halfH = this.frameCtx?.viewH ? this.frameCtx.viewH / 2 : 540;
    const px = this.amb.playerX;
    const edgeX = dir > 0 ? px - halfW - 100 : px + halfW + 100;   // :452-459
    const uwPx = this.underworldLayerPx();
    const mk = (sx: number, sy: number, depth: number, life: number, texKey: string, rows: number, variant: number) =>
      this.mkAmbient(kind, sx, sy, depth, dir, life, camX, camY, texKey, rows, variant);

    // EOCSkyEntity 族（:1238-1258）：3/4 折线 / 1/4 追玩家；定位不走常规 y 带
    if (spec.eoc) {
      const depth = spec.depthMin + r() * spec.depthSpan;
      const t = this.ambientTexKey(kind, r, depth);
      const life = (spec.life[0] + Math.floor(r() * (spec.life[1] - spec.life[0]))) * 60;
      let e: AmbientEnt;
      if (Math.floor(r() * 4) !== 0) {
        // BeginZigZag :1260-1276：dir 掷（1 右进/−1 左进）、y=相机顶、x 对侧屏外
        const d: 1 | -1 = Math.floor(r() * 2) === 1 ? 1 : -1;
        e = mk(d === 1 ? camX - halfW - 100 : camX + halfW + 100, camY - halfH, depth, life, t.key, t.rows, t.variant);
        e.state = 1; e.dir = d; e.waviness = 1 + r();
      } else {
        // BeginChasingPlayer :1278-1283：相机矩形内随机点
        e = mk(camX - halfW + r() * halfW * 2, camY - halfH + r() * halfH * 2, depth, life, t.key, t.rows, t.variant);
        e.state = 2;
      }
      this.ambEntities.push(e);
      return;
    }
    // AirBalloon（:1130-1147）：锚玩家列 ±100 格、地表上 50-80 格
    if (kind === 'airballoon') {
      const depth = spec.depthMin + r() * spec.depthSpan;
      const t = this.ambientTexKey(kind, r, depth);
      const life = (spec.life[0] + Math.floor(r() * (spec.life[1] - spec.life[0]))) * 60;
      const sx = (Math.floor(px / 16) + 100 * (r() * 2 - 1)) * 16;
      const sy = this.fx.surfaceY - (50 + Math.floor(r() * 31)) * 16;
      this.ambEntities.push(mk(sx, sy, depth, life, t.key, t.rows, t.variant));
      return;
    }
    // 常规 y 带（:201/:246/:304/:353/:411/:459/:511/:624/:731/:942/:1041/:1097）
    const bandY = () => spec.hellBand
      ? uwPx + r() * 800                                          // HellBats CreateGroup :890
      : r() * Math.max(0, this.fx.surfaceY - spec.ySub - spec.yOff) + spec.yOff;
    const depth = () => spec.depthMin + r() * spec.depthSpan;
    const life = () => (spec.life[0] + Math.floor(r() * (spec.life[1] - spec.life[0]))) * 60;
    if (group) {
      // CreateGroup（各族 :564-598/:672-705/:771-804/:874-907/:990-1023）
      const count = group.count[0] + Math.floor(r() * (group.count[1] - group.count[0]));
      const baseY = bandY();
      const baseDepth = depth();
      const baseLife = life();
      const accX = group.accX[0] + r() * group.accX[1];
      const accY = group.accY[0] + r() * group.accY[1];
      const tX = (r() * 2 - 1) * group.target, tY = (r() * 2 - 1) * group.target;
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const d = baseDepth + r() * group.depthJitter;
        const tex = this.ambientTexKey(kind, r, d);
        const ox = (r() * 20 - 10) * group.spread, oy = r() * 3 * group.spread;
        const e = mk(edgeX + ox, baseY + oy, d, baseLife + Math.floor(r() * group.lifeJitter), tex.key, tex.rows, tex.variant);
        const k = (r() * group.factorA + group.factorB) * 0.05;
        e.magAccX = accX * k; e.magAccY = accY * k;
        e.magTX = tX; e.magTY = tY;
        this.ambEntities.push(e);
      }
      return;
    }
    // 单体族
    const d = depth();
    const tex = this.ambientTexKey(kind, r, d);
    this.ambEntities.push(mk(edgeX, bandY(), d, life(), tex.key, tex.rows, tex.variant));
    void windT; void storming;
  }

So for groups, baseLife = group.baseLife (30-60s), not spec.life. My AMBIENT_GROUP_SPEC has baseLife field — use it! Same for seagulls (Next(30,61)*60 :583), slime (Next(80,121)*60 :789 — matches spec.life [80,121]), bats (Next(30,61)*60), hellbats (Next(30,61)*60).

stepAmbientEntity per-family velocity:

```ts
  private stepAmbientEntity(e: AmbientEnt, frame: number, wind: number): void {
    const spec = AMBIENT_FAMILY_PARAMS[e.kind];
    const age = frame - e.bornAt;
    if (age >= e.life) { e.dead = true; return; }
    e.opacity = age >= e.life * e.fadeOut
      ? lerpValueClamped(e.life, e.life * e.fadeOut, age)
      : lerpValueClamped(0, e.life * e.fadeIn, age);
    // 帧推进 :110-113（(frame+FrameOffset)%FramingSpeed==0 → 下一行）
    const fs = e.kind === 'lostkite' && this.storming() ? 4 : e.framingSpeed;
    if (fs < 0x7fffffff && ((frame + e.frameOffset) % fs) === 0) {
      e.frame = (e.frame + 1) % e.rows;
    }
    // SlimeBalloons/LostKite 每帧按风重估朝向（:758/:280）
    if (e.kind === 'slimeBalloons' || e.kind === 'lostkite') e.dir = wind > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const group = AMBIENT_GROUP_SPEC[e.kind];
    if (spec.eoc) {
      // EOCSkyEntity.UpdateVelocity :1285-1297
      if (e.state === 1) {
        e.vx = e.dir * 3;
        e.vy = Math.cos((frame / 1200) * Math.PI * 2) * e.waviness;
      } else {
        const p = this.frameCtx?.player;
        if (p) {
          const dx = p.cx - e.x, dy = (p.cy - 500) - e.y;
          if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) >= 100) {
            e.vx += 0.1 * Math.sign(dx);
            e.vy += 0.1 * Math.sign(dy);
            e.vx = Math.max(-18, Math.min(18, e.vx));
            e.vy = Math.max(-18, Math.min(18, e.vy));
          }
        }
      }
      e.rotation = Math.atan2(e.vy, e.vx);
    } else if (group) {
      // 磁吸弹簧（:530-537 同构）：加速度 × sign(目标-偏移)
      e.magVX += e.magAccX * Math.sign(e.magTX - e.magPX);
      e.magVY += e.magAccY * Math.sign(e.magTY - e.magPY);
      e.magPX += e.magVX; e.magPY += e.magVY;
      e.vx = (spec.speedA + Math.abs(wind) * spec.speedB) * e.dir + e.magVX;
      e.vy = (spec.vy ?? 0) + e.magVY;
      if (e.kind === 'gastropod' || e.kind === 'slimeBalloons') e.rotation = e.vx * 0.1;
    } else if (e.kind === 'airballoon') {
      // :1149-1165：vx = wind*4；vy = -(3+|wind|)，高空三档减半
      e.vx = wind * 4;
      let rise = 3 + Math.abs(wind);
      const surfTiles = this.fx.surfaceY / 16;
      if (e.y < surfTiles * 12) rise *= 0.5;
      if (e.y < surfTiles * 8) rise *= 0.5;
      if (e.y < surfTiles * 4) rise *= 0.5;
      e.vy = -rise;
    } else if (e.kind === 'lostkite') {
      // :264-272：1.2+|wind|*3，风暴 ×1.5
      let v = spec.speedA + Math.abs(wind) * spec.speedB;
      if (this.storming()) v *= 1.5;
      e.vx = v * e.dir; e.vy = 0;
    } else {
      e.vx = (spec.speedA + Math.abs(wind) * spec.speedB) * e.dir;
      e.vy = 0;
    }
    e.x += e.vx; e.y += e.vy;
  }

  private ambientEnvGate(e: AmbientEnt, frame: number): void {
    const a = this.amb;
    const rainDayEclipse = a.raining || !a.dayTime || a.eclipse;    // :481 同构（8 族共用）
    let out = false;
    switch (e.kind) {
      case 'gastropod':
        out = a.raining || a.dayTime || a.bloodMoon || a.moonEventKind === 2 || a.moonEventKind === 1; break;  // :650
      case 'pixieposse':
        out = (e.variant === 1 && !a.dayTime) || (e.variant === 2 && a.dayTime) || a.raining || a.eclipse
          || a.bloodMoon || a.moonEventKind === 2 || a.moonEventKind === 1; break;                            // :432
      case 'slimeBalloons':
        out = !this.windyDay() || a.raining || !a.dayTime || a.eclipse; break;                                 // :759
      case 'lostkite':
        out = !a.dayTime || a.eclipse; break;                                                                 // :282
      case 'birds': case 'vulture': case 'pegasus': case 'seagulls': case 'airship': case 'airballoon':
      case 'butterflies': case 'bats':
        out = rainDayEclipse; break;
      default: out = false; break;    // wyvern/eyeball/eos/crimera/hellbats 无环境门
    }
    if (out) this.ambientStartFadingOut(e, frame);
  }

```ts
  private storming(): boolean { return !!this.weatherRef?.shouldUseStormMusic; }
  private windyDay(): boolean { return !!this.weatherRef?.shouldUseWindyDayMusic; }
  private hardMode(): boolean { return !!this.frameCtx?.world?.flags?.hardMode; }
  private underworldLayerPx(): number {
    const fc = this.frameCtx;
    if (!fc?.world) return 0;
    return ((fc.world.lavaLine || (fc.world.h - 200)) * 16);
  }
  private isSunset(): boolean {
    const fc = this.frameCtx;
    if (!fc?.clock) return false;
    return fc.clock.isDay && fc.clock.timeOfDay > 0.625;   // Main.time>40500 → timeOfDay>0.25+40500/54000*0.5
  }

}

}\n  /** Main.IsItAHappyWindyDay（Main.cs:2976 = _shouldUseWindyDayMusic） */\n  private windyDay(): boolean { return !!this.weatherRef?.shouldUseWindyDayMusic; }\n  private hardMode(): boolean { return !!this.frameCtx?.world?.flags?.hardMode; }\n\n  /** 地狱顶 px（Main.UnderworldLayer = maxTilesY-200；lavaLine 缺省回退） */\n  underworldLayerPx(): number {\n    const fc = this.frameCtx;\n    if (!fc?.world) return 0;\n    return (fc.world.lavaLine || (fc.world.h - 200)) * 16;\n  }\n\n  /** IsSunset（AmbienceServer.cs:39-46：白天且 Main.time>40500 → timeOfDay>0.625） */\n  private isSunset(): boolean {\n    const c = this.frameCtx?.clock;\n    return !!c && c.isDay && c.timeOfDay > 0.625;\n  }\n\n  /** NPC.butterflyChance<6（AmbienceServer.cs:65）。NPC.cs:94583-94599 每日黎明掷：\n   *  1/3 无蝶；否则 Next(1,21) 且 1/5 无蝶 → <6 仅约 13% 的日子有天空蝶群 */\n  private butterflyChanceLow(): boolean {\n    const day = this.frameCtx?.clock?.dayCount ?? -1;\n    if (day !== this.butterflyDay) {\n      this.butterflyDay = day;\n      if (Math.random() < 1 / 3) this.butterflyChance = 999999;\n      else {\n        this.butterflyChance = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);\n        if (Math.random() < 1 / 5) this.butterflyChance = 999999;\n      }\n    }\n    return this.butterflyChance < 6;\n  }\n\n  /** 月总在场（SceneState.cs:109 ClosestNPCPosition[398] != Zero → MoonLord 天空激活，\n   *  同时 :1362-1369 与 Ambience 冲突） */\n  private moonLordPresent(): boolean { return this.dramaCore !== null; }\n\n  // ================= 月塔天空装饰层（Nebula/Solar/Stardust/Vortex Sky 1:1） =================\n\n  /** 四塔族索引（SceneState.cs:111-115 MonolithType 映射：0 星璇/1 星云/2 星尘/3 耀斑） */\n  private static readonly TOWER_FAMILY = ['vortex', 'nebula', 'stardust', 'solar'] as const;\n  /** 塔族 → 塔 NPC id（NPCID：422 星璇 / 507 星云 / 493 星尘 / 517 耀斑） */\n  private static readonly TOWER_NPC: Record<TowerFamily, number> =\n    { vortex: 422, nebula: 507, stardust: 493, solar: 517 };\n\n  private towerSky: Record<TowerFamily, TowerSkyState> = {\n    vortex: new TowerSkyState('vortex'), nebula: new TowerSkyState('nebula'),\n    stardust: new TowerSkyState('stardust'), solar: new TowerSkyState('solar'),\n  };\n\n  clearTowerSky(): void {\n    for (const k of SkyRenderer.TOWER_FAMILY) this.towerSky[k].reset();\n  }\n\n  /** SceneState.ApplyVisuals :105-115 每帧扫描：近距门（SceneMetrics.cs:276-282/921-928\n   *  距离²≤4000²）+ 器件门（!flag4 && ActiveMonolithType==N）→ Activate/Deactivate */\n  private updateTowerSky(): void {\n    const fc = this.frameCtx;\n    const player = fc?.player;\n    const monolith = this.fx.monolith;\n    const near: Partial<Record<TowerFamily, boolean>> = {};\n    let anyTowerNear = false;\n    if (fc && player) {\n      for (const fam of SkyRenderer.TOWER_FAMILY) {\n        const npcId = SkyRenderer.TOWER_NPC[fam];\n        let found = false;\n        for (const e of fc.entities) {\n          if (e.vanillaId !== npcId || e.dead) continue;\n          const d2 = (e.cx - player.cx) ** 2 + (e.cy - player.cy) ** 2;\n          if (d2 <= 4000 * 4000) { found = true; break; }   // NPCEventZoneRadius（SceneMetrics.cs:130）\n        }\n        near[fam] = found;\n        if (found) anyTowerNear = true;\n      }\n    }\n    SkyRenderer.TOWER_FAMILY.forEach((fam, idx) => {\n      const active = towerSkyActive(!!near[fam], monolith, idx, anyTowerNear);\n      this.towerSky[fam].setActive(active);\n    });\n  }\n\n  /** 绘制四塔天空层（sky.draw 星星之后、日月之前——原版 SkyManager 远景层在星星后） */\n  private drawTowerSky(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, viewW: number, viewH: number,\n    camX: number, camY: number, dtMs: number, timeSec: number): void {\n    this.updateTowerSky();\n    const fc = this.frameCtx;\n    const maxTilesX = fc?.world?.w ?? Math.round(this.fx.worldW);\n    const surfacePx = this.fx.surfaceY;\n    const screenX = camX - viewW / 2, screenY = camY - viewH / 2;\n    for (const fam of SkyRenderer.TOWER_FAMILY) {\n      this.towerSky[fam].update(dtMs);\n      this.towerSky[fam].draw(ctx, fam, viewW, viewH, screenX, screenY, maxTilesX, surfacePx, timeSec);\n    }\n    // GetCloudAlpha() = (1-fade)*0.3+0.7（四族同）——返回给云层消费\n  }\n\n  /** 当前塔天空云量乘子（GetCloudAlpha 四族同式；任一激活即取最小） */\n  towerCloudAlphaMul(): number {\n    let mul = 1;\n    for (const fam of SkyRenderer.TOWER_FAMILY) {\n      if (this.towerSky[fam].fade > 0.001) {\n        mul = Math.min(mul, (1 - this.towerSky[fam].fade) * 0.3 + 0.7);\n      }\n    }\n    return mul;\n  }\n\n  // ================= 月总死亡戏剧（MoonlordDeathDrama.cs 1:1） =================\n  // 消费锚点：ThrowPieces = NPC.cs:83496（398 终死 HitEffect(0,1337)）；\n  // AddExplosion = NPC.cs:36982（死亡态 ai0==2，ai1%3==0 且 60<ai1<580）；\n  // RequestLight = :36796/:36820（出生态 -1/-2 闪白 ai1/30）与 :37055（死亡态 ≥480 段）。\n  // 任务描述\"登场爆炸\"系推测有误：Misc/MoonExplosion 五件贴图全部挂在**死亡**戏剧。\n\n  private dramaCore: { cx: number; cy: number; ai0: number; ai1: number } | null = null;\n  private dramaPieces: DramaPiece[] = [];\n  private dramaExplosions: DramaExplosion[] = [];\n  /** whitening/requestedLight（:154-156）——MoveTowards 0.02/帧 */\n  private dramaWhitening = 0;\n  private dramaRequestedLight = 0;\n  private dramaLightRequestedThisFrame = false;\n\n  clearMoonlordDrama(): void {\n    this.dramaCore = null;\n    this.dramaPieces = [];\n    this.dramaExplosions = [];\n    this.dramaWhitening = 0;\n    this.dramaRequestedLight = 0;\n  }\n\n  /** 每帧扫描 398（Renderer frameCtx.entities）→ 死亡戏剧触发/爆炸/白光请求 */\n  private updateMoonlordDrama(dtFrames: number): void {\n    const fc = this.frameCtx;\n    const world = fc?.world ?? null;\n    let core: { cx: number; cy: number; ai0: number; ai1: number } | null = null;\n    if (fc) {\n      for (const e of fc.entities) {\n        if (e.vanillaId !== 398 || e.dead) continue;\n        core = { cx: e.cx, cy: e.cy, ai0: e.ai0, ai1: e.ai1 };\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n    const prev = this.dramaCore;\n    this.dramaCore = core;\n    this.dramaLightRequestedThisFrame = false;\n\n    if (core) {\n      // 死亡演出段（ai0==2）：每 3t 一簇爆炎（:36981-36998，落点须界内非实心）\n      if (core.ai0 === 2 && core.ai1 % 3 === 0 && core.ai1 > 60 && core.ai1 < 580) {\n        const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;\n        const rad = 20 + Math.random() * 400;\n        const ex = core.cx + Math.cos(ang) * rad, ey = core.cy + Math.sin(ang) * rad;\n        const tx = Math.floor(ex / 16), ty = Math.floor(ey / 16);\n        const ok = world ? (world.store.inBounds(tx, ty) && !world.store.isSolid(tx, ty)) : true;\n        if (ok) this.addMoonlordExplosion(ex, ey);\n      }\n      // 白光请求：出生态 -1/-2（ai1<60 → ai1/30）与死亡态尾段（≥480 → (ai1-480)/120）\n      if ((core.ai0 === -1 || core.ai0 === -2) && core.ai1 < 60) {\n        this.requestDramaLight(core.ai1 / 30, core.cx, core.cy);   // :36796/:36820\n      } else if (core.ai0 === 2 && core.ai1 >= 480) {\n        this.requestDramaLight((core.ai1 - 480) / 120, core.cx, core.cy);  // :37055\n      }\n      // 终死（ai1≥600 → life=0 + HitEffect(0,1337) → ThrowPieces）：掷点跨线或实体消失兜底\n      const diedNow = prev !== null && prev.ai1 < 600 && core.ai1 >= 600 && core.ai0 === 2;\n      const vanished = prev !== null && prev.ai0 === 2 && prev.ai1 >= 590;\n      if (diedNow || vanished) {\n        this.throwMoonlordPieces(vanished && !diedNow ? prev.cx : core.cx,\n          vanished && !diedNow ? prev.cy : core.cy, Math.floor(Math.random() * 100));\n      }\n    }\n    // Update :158-196：碎片/爆炸推进 + 白光 0.02/帧 逼近（无光源请求 → 目标 0）\n    for (const p of this.dramaPieces) p.update(world?.w ?? 0, world?.h ?? 0);\n    this.dramaPieces = this.dramaPieces.filter((p) => !p.dead);\n    for (const ex of this.dramaExplosions) ex.update();\n    this.dramaExplosions = this.dramaExplosions.filter((ex) => !ex.dead);\n    if (!this.dramaLightRequestedThisFrame) this.dramaRequestedLight = 0;   // :190-193\n    const target = this.dramaRequestedLight;\n    this.dramaWhitening += Math.max(-0.02, Math.min(0.02, target - this.dramaWhitening)) * dtFrames;\n    this.dramaWhitening = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, this.dramaWhitening));\n  }\n\n  /** ThrowPieces（:231-242）：四件骨骼碎块自核心飞散（UnitY 旋 ±π/4+π 的 6/10/8/12 速） */\n  private throwMoonlordPieces(cx: number, cy: number, seed: number): void {\n    if (this.dramaPieces.length > 0) return;   // 一次死亡一组\n    const r = seededRandom(seed);\n    const defs: Array<[DramaPieceKind, number, number, number, number, number]> = [\n      // [件, originX, originY, 距核心偏移x, 偏移y, 速度]\n      ['spine', 64, 150, 0, 50, 6],        // :235\n      ['shoulder', 40, 120, 50, -120, 10], // :237\n      ['torso', 192, 252, 0, 0, 8],        // :239\n      ['head', 138, 185, 0, -200, 12],     // :241\n    ];\n    for (const [kind, ox, oy, dx, dy, spd] of defs) {\n      const ang = Math.random() * (Math.PI / 2) - Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI;\n      void r;\n      this.dramaPieces.push(new DramaPiece(kind, cx + dx, cy + dy,\n        Math.cos(ang) * spd, Math.sin(ang) * spd, ox, oy,\n        Math.random() * 0.1 - 0.05));\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** AddExplosion（:244-247）：7 帧爆炎，帧速 Next(2,4) */\n  addMoonlordExplosion(x: number, y: number): void {\n    this.dramaExplosions.push(new DramaExplosion(x, y, 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2)));\n  }\n\n  /** RequestLight（:249-260）：本帧光源 + 目标取 max（钳 1） */\n  private requestDramaLight(light: number, x: number, y: number): void {\n    const player = this.frameCtx?.player;\n    // :181-188 光源须距 metrics.Center <2000 才生效\n    if (player && Math.hypot(player.cx - x, player.cy - y) >= 2000) return;\n    this.dramaLightRequestedThisFrame = true;\n    const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, light));\n    if (v > this.dramaRequestedLight) this.dramaRequestedLight = v;\n  }\n\n  /** DrawPieces/DrawExplosions（:198-220）：世界位 - screenPosition；原版画在 tile 层\n   *  之前（Main.cs:62711-62712，WoF/背景碎块之后）——本仓在 pre-world 变换段调用 */\n  private drawMoonlordDrama(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, camX: number, camY: number,\n    viewW: number, viewH: number, z: number): void {\n    this.updateMoonlordDrama(1);\n    if (!this.dramaPieces.length && !this.dramaExplosions.length) return;\n    const screenX = camX - viewW / 2, screenY = camY - viewH / 2;\n    const sx = (wx: number) => (wx - screenX) * z;\n    const sy = (wy: number) => (wy - screenY) * z;\n    // 屏中心 ±(视口+1000) 剔除（:200/:212）\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;\n    for (const p of this.dramaPieces) {\n      const px = sx(p.x), py = sy(p.y);\n      if (px < -1000 || px > viewW + 1000 || py < -1000 || py > viewH + 1000) continue;\n      const tex = dramaTex(p.kind);\n      if (!tex || !tex.complete || !tex.naturalWidth) continue;\n      ctx.save();\n      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n      ctx.translate(px, py);\n      ctx.rotate(p.rot);\n      ctx.drawImage(tex, -p.ox, -p.oy);\n      ctx.restore();\n    }\n    for (const ex of this.dramaExplosions) {\n      const px = sx(ex.x), py = sy(ex.y);\n      if (px < -1000 || px > viewW + 1000 || py < -1000 || py > viewH + 1000) continue;\n      const tex = dramaTex('explosion');\n      if (!tex || !tex.complete || !tex.naturalWidth) continue;\n      const fw = tex.naturalWidth, fh = tex.naturalHeight / 7;   // Frame(1,7)（:121）\n      ctx.save();\n      ctx.globalAlpha = 127 / 255;                                // GetLight :142-145 恒 (255,255,255,127)\n      ctx.drawImage(tex, 0, Math.min(6, Math.floor(ex.counter / ex.speed)) * fh, fw, fh,\n        px - fw / 2, py - fh / 2, fw, fh);\n      ctx.restore();\n    }\n    ctx.restore();\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n  }\n\n  /** DrawWhite（:222-229）：全屏白 × whitening。原版画在 ScreenDarkness.DrawFront 之后\n   *  （Main.cs:61763，几乎最末）；本仓在世界变换段以恒等变换近似（登记：位置偏早） */\n  private drawMoonlordWhitening(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, viewW: number, viewH: number): void {\n    if (this.dramaWhitening <= 0.001) return;\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);\n    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, this.dramaWhitening);\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewW, viewH);\n    ctx.restore();\n  }\n\n  // ================= 晨昏耀斑（NextHorizonRenderer Sunflare 族 1:1） =================\n  // 消费锚点勘误：Sunflare 与日耀塔**无关**——全部挂在晨昏地平线系统\n  // （DrawSun :171-184 / DrawLensFlare :368-541 / DrawSurfaceLayer(3) :141-147）。\n\n  /** 本帧太阳屏幕位（sky.draw 写入；镜头光斑轴用） */\n  private sunScreen: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;\n  private sunflareTex: Partial<Record<SunflareTex, HTMLImageElement>> = {};\n\n  /** GetVisibilities（NextHorizonRenderer.cs:199-239 一比一）：\n   *  atmo ×(1-cloudAlpha)² ×(1-蘑菇光影响[无→1])；日出窗 = time∈(0,2700)↑·(3600,10800)↓；\n   *  日落窗 = 54000−10800..−3600 ↑ 与 −3600..54000 ↓²；夜/日食清零 */\n  private sunVisibilities(dayTimeTicks: number, isDay: boolean, eclipse: boolean, atmo: number,\n    cloudAlpha: number): { sunset: number; sunrise: number; celestial: number } {\n    const celestial = this.celestialEffectPower(dayTimeTicks, isDay);   // :315-325\n    let vis = atmo * (1 - cloudAlpha) * (1 - cloudAlpha);               // :205-209\n    let sunrise = vis, sunset = vis;\n    if (isDay) {\n      // :215-223（Remap 单调钳位插值）\n      sunrise *= remap(dayTimeTicks, 0, 2700, 0, 1) * remap(dayTimeTicks, 3600, 10800, 1, 0);\n      sunset *= remap(dayTimeTicks, 54000 - 10800, 54000 - 3600, 0, 1)\n        * remap(dayTimeTicks, 54000 - 3600, 54000, 1, 0) ** 2;\n      if (eclipse) { sunrise = 0; sunset = 0; }                          // :224-228\n    } else {\n      sunrise = 0; sunset = 0;                                           // :230-234\n    }\n    void celestial;\n    return { sunset, sunrise, celestial };\n  }\n\n  /** GetCelestialEffectPower（:315-325）：天体高度驱动的整体强度 */\n  private celestialEffectPower(dayTimeTicks: number, isDay: boolean): number {\n    if (isDay) {\n      return remap(dayTimeTicks, 0, 3600, 0, 1) * remap(dayTimeTicks, 54000 - 1800, 54000, 1, 0);\n    }\n    return remap(dayTimeTicks, 0, 3600, 0, 1) * remap(dayTimeTicks, 32400 - 1800, 32400, 1, 0);\n  }\n\n  private sunflareTexLoad(key: SunflareTex): HTMLImageElement | null {\n    let t = this.sunflareTex[key];\n    if (!t) {\n      t = loadTex(SUNFLARE_TEX_FILE[key]);\n      this.sunflareTex[key] = t;\n    }\n    return t;\n  }\n\n  /** DrawSun（:171-184）：太阳位的 flare1/flare2 光晕（晨昏可见性驱动）。\n   *  原版经 LensFlare shader（alpha 0 靠混合态出彩）；canvas 以 lighter 叠加近似。 */\n  private drawSunflareGlow(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, sunX: number, sunY: number,\n    sunset: number, sunrise: number): void {\n    if (sunset <= 0.01 && sunrise <= 0.01) return;\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';\n    const draws: Array<[SunflareTex, number, number]> = [\n      ['flare1', sunset * 0.75, 3],     // :179\n      ['flare1', sunset * 0.35, 2],     // :180\n      ['flare2', sunrise * 0.7 * 0.5, 2],   // :181\n      ['flare2', sunrise * 0.3 * 0.5, 1.5], // :182\n      ['flare2', sunrise * 0.2 * 0.5, 1],   // :183\n    ];\n    for (const [key, alpha, scale] of draws) {\n      if (alpha <= 0.01) continue;\n      const tex = this.sunflareTexLoad(key);\n      if (!tex || !tex.complete || !tex.naturalWidth) continue;\n      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, alpha);\n      ctx.drawImage(tex, sunX - (tex.naturalWidth * scale) / 2, sunY - (tex.naturalHeight * scale) / 2,\n        tex.naturalWidth * scale, tex.naturalHeight * scale);\n    }\n    ctx.restore();\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n  }\n\n  /** DrawSurfaceLayer(3)（:141-147）：colorgradient 晨昏渐变带（日出水平翻转） */\n  private drawSunflareGradientBand(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, viewW: number, viewH: number,\n    screenY: number, sunset: number, sunrise: number): void {\n    if (sunset <= 0.01 && sunrise <= 0.01) return;\n    const tex = this.sunflareTexLoad('colorgradient');\n    if (!tex || !tex.complete || !tex.naturalWidth) return;\n    // GetGradientRect（:66-72）：val=(1-Lerp(40,worldSurface,screenY/16))×400，y=max(0,val)−400\n    const surfaceTiles = this.fx.surfaceY / 16;\n    const val = (1 - lerpValueClamped(40, surfaceTiles, screenY / 16)) * 400;\n    const y = Math.max(0, val) - 400;\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'overlay';\n    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;\n    if (sunrise > 0.01) {\n      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, sunrise * 0.6);                  // ×num2=0.6（:145）\n      ctx.save();\n      ctx.translate(viewW, 0);\n      ctx.scale(-1, 1);                                             // FlipHorizontally\n      ctx.drawImage(tex, 0, y, viewW, viewH + 400);\n      ctx.restore();\n    }\n    if (sunset > 0.01) {\n      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, sunset * 0.6);                  // :146\n      ctx.drawImage(tex, 0, y, viewW, viewH + 400);\n    }\n    ctx.restore();\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n  }\n\n  /** DrawLensFlare（:368-541）：太阳↔屏心轴上的镜头光斑串。\n   *  原版为 Immediate 模式 shader（Main.cs:61760 末段后处理）；本仓在世界变换段\n   *  恒等变换绘制（登记：层级偏早、无 SunVisibilityPixel 遮挡采样） */\n  private drawLensFlare(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, viewW: number, viewH: number,\n    sunset: number, sunrise: number, celestial: number): void {\n    const sun = this.sunScreen;\n    if (!sun) return;\n    // AdjustIntensity（:393-408）：intensity = temporal³ × celestial（无 sunScorch）\n    const num = (sunrise * celestial) ** 3 * celestial;\n    const num2 = (sunset * celestial) ** 3 * celestial;\n    if (num <= 0.01 && num2 <= 0.01) return;\n    const cx = viewW / 2, cy = viewH / 2;\n    const baseRot = Math.atan2(cy - sun.y, cx - sun.x) + sun.y * 0.001;   // :46-49\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);\n    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';\n    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;\n    if (num2 > 0.01) this.drawLensFlareSet(ctx, sun.x, sun.y, cx, cy, baseRot, num2, 'sunset');\n    if (num > 0.01) this.drawLensFlareSet(ctx, sun.x, sun.y, cx, cy, baseRot, num, 'sunrise');\n    ctx.restore();\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n  }\n\n  /** DrawSunsetFlare / DrawSunriseFlare 元素表（:410-541 逐元素 1:1） */\n  private drawLensFlareSet(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, sunX: number, sunY: number,\n    cx: number, cy: number, baseRot: number, intensity: number, which: 'sunset' | 'sunrise'): void {\n    // [贴图, RepeatTimes, ScaleStart, ScaleOverIndex, DistanceStart, DistanceAlongIndex, RGB, 强度乘, 旋转]\n    const C = which === 'sunset' ? 0.47058824 : 0.47058824;\n    const sets: Array<[SunflareTex, number, number, number, number, number, [number, number, number], number, number]> =\n      which === 'sunset' ? function seededRandom(seed: number): () => number {

                                 // :121\n        ctx.globalAlpha = a;\n        ctx.drawImage(tex, px, py, tex.naturalWidth * s, tex.naturalHeight * s);\n      }\n    }\n    ctx.restore();\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n  }\n}\n\n// ================= 月总死亡戏剧件（MoonlordDeathDrama.cs :12-146） =================\n\ntype DramaPieceKind = 'spine' | 'shoulder' | 'torso' | 'head' | 'explosion';\n\nconst DRAMA_TEX_FILE: Record<DramaPieceKind, string> = {\n  spine: 'Misc_MoonExplosion_Spine.png',\n  shoulder: 'Misc_MoonExplosion_Shoulder.png',\n  torso: 'Misc_MoonExplosion_Torso.png',\n  head: 'Misc_MoonExplosion_Head.png',\n  explosion: 'Misc_MoonExplosion_Explosion.png',\n};\n\nconst dramaTexCache = new Map<DramaPieceKind, HTMLImageElement>();\nfunction dramaTex(kind: DramaPieceKind): HTMLImageElement | null {\n  if (typeof Image === 'undefined') return null;\n  let t = dramaTexCache.get(kind);\n  if (!t) {\n    t = new Image();\n    t.src = `sprites/vanilla/${DRAMA_TEX_FILE[kind]}`;\n    dramaTexCache.set(kind, t);\n  }\n  return t;\n}\n\n/** MoonlordPiece（:12-87）：重力 0.3 + 角速度衰减 0.99 + 出界判死 */\nclass DramaPiece {\n  rot = 0;\n  dead = false;\n  constructor(\n    readonly kind: DramaPieceKind,\n    public x: number, public y: number,\n    public vx: number, public vy: number,\n    readonly ox: number, readonly oy: number,   // 贴图 origin（:235-241 显式值）\n    readonly rotV: number,\n  ) {}\n  update(maxTilesX: number, maxTilesY: number): void {\n    this.vy += 0.3;                              // :50\n    this.rot += this.rotV;                       // :51\n    this.rotV *= 0.99;                           // :52\n    this.x += this.vx; this.y += this.vy;        // :53\n    if (this.y > maxTilesY * 16 - 480 || this.x < 480 || this.x >= maxTilesX * 16 - 480) {\n      this.dead = true;                          // :26-36\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/** MoonlordExplosion（:89-146）：7 帧竖条，帧速 2-4，恒 (255,255,255,127) */\nclass DramaExplosion {\n  counter = 0;\n  dead = false;\n  constructor(public x: number, public y: number, readonly speed: number) {}\n  update(): void {\n    this.counter++;                              // :127\n    if (this.counter >= this.speed * 7) this.dead = true;   // :103-113\n  }\n}\n\n/** UnifiedRandom(seed) 的确定性替身（ThrowPieces 四件散射角序列按种子定）。\n *  非 .NET 位级同源（MS RNG 内部状态不公开），只保证同种子同序列（登记）。 */\nfunction seededRandom(seed: number): () => number {\n  let s = (seed <= 0 ? 1 : seed) >>> 0;\n  return () => {\n    s = (Math.imul(s ^ 0x9e3779b9, 25214903917) + 11) >>> 0;\n    return s / 0x100000000;\n  };\n}\n\n// ================= 晨昏耀斑贴图（Misc/Sunflare/*） =================\n\ntype SunflareTex = 'flare1' | 'flare2' | 'bokeh' | 'spectra' | 'pointblurry' | 'pointsharp' | 'colorgradient';\n\nconst SUNFLARE_TEX_FILE: Record<SunflareTex, string> = {\n  flare1: 'Misc_Sunflare_flare1.png',\n  flare2: 'Misc_Sunflare_flare2.png',\n  bokeh: 'Misc_Sunflare_Lens_Flare1.png',\n  spectra: 'Misc_Sunflare_Lens_Flare2.png',\n  pointblurry: 'Misc_Sunflare_Lens_PointBlurry.png',\n  pointsharp: 'Misc_Sunflare_Lens_PointSharp.png',\n  colorgradient: 'Misc_Sunflare_colorgradient.png',\n};\n\n/** 镜头元素乘色缓存（lighter 叠加前先 multiply 着色——LensFlareElement.Color :422 等） */\nconst flareTintCache = new Map<string, HTMLCanvasElement>();\nfunction tintedFlareSprite(tex: HTMLImageElement, r: number, g: number, b: number): HTMLCanvasElement | null {\n  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;\n  const key = `${tex.src}|${r},${g},${b}`;\n  const hit = flareTintCache.get(key);\n  if (hit) return hit;\n  const c = document.createElement('canvas');\n  c.width = tex.naturalWidth; c.height = tex.naturalHeight;\n  const cx = c.getContext('2d')!;\n  cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;\n  cx.drawImage(tex, 0, 0);\n  cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';\n  cx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;\n  cx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);\n  cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';\n  cx.drawImage(tex, 0, 0);\n  flareTintCache.set(key, c);\n  if (flareTintCache.size > 24) {\n    const first = flareTintCache.keys().next().value;\n    if (first !== undefined) flareTintCache.delete(first);\n  }\n  return c;\n}\n\n/** 帧数据挂点（Renderer.render 每帧一行注入 sky.frameCtx；结构化类型避免反向依赖）。"

 "new_string": "  /** 暴风雪循环轨渐入渐出（SceneState.cs:252 _blizzardSoundVolume：MoveTowards(flag?1:0, 0.01)/帧） */\n  blizzardSoundVolume = 0;\n  /** 室外天气效果强度（SceneState.cs:190-191：BehindBackwall ? -0.1 : 1.1，\n   *  0.005/帧 逼近后钳 0-1 → outsideWeatherEffectIntensity） */\n  outsideWeatherEffect = 1;\n  /** 雨点落水涟漪池（渲染侧采样入池；update 推进 t） */\n  ripples: WaterRipple[] = [];\n\n  /** 每帧涟漪采样预算（cloudAlpha × 屏宽比例；纯读状态可单测）：\n   *  雨越强/视口越宽越多，上限 24。cloudAlpha≤0（无雨）恒 0。 */\n  rippleBudget(viewW: number): number {\n    if (this.cloudAlpha <= 0) return 0;\n    return Math.min(24, Math.round(this.cloudAlpha * (viewW / 1920) * 6));\n  }\n\n  /** 入池一枚（容量封顶 RIPPLE_CAP，溢出丢弃） */\n  pushRipple(x: number, y: number): boolean {\n    if (this.ripples.length >= RIPPLE_CAP) return false;\n    this.ripples.push({ x, y, t: 0, life: RIPPLE_LIFE });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /** 涟漪推进（update 尾段；dayRate 缩放） */\n  private updateRipples(dayRate: number): void {\n    if (!this.ripples.length) return;\n    for (const rp of this.ripples) rp.t += dayRate;\n    this.ripples = this.ripples.filter((rp) => rp.t < rp.life);\n  }"

```
// 实体基类与分桶管理器
import type { GameHooks } from './types';
import type { Camera } from '../render/Camera';
import type { Renderer } from '../render/Renderer';

export abstract class Entity {
  id = 0;
  x = 0; y = 0;          // 左上角 px
  w = 16; h = 16;
  vx = 0; vy = 0;
  dead = false;
  onGround = false;
  hitWall = false;
  hitHead = false;
  dropThrough = false;
  /** 液体位移减速因子（原版 waterMovementSpeed 族，NPC.cs:5946 默认 水/岩浆 .5、
   *  蜂蜜 .25、微光 .375）。1=dry 不减速；Enemy 侧 npcLiquid.updateNpcLiquid 每 tick 写，
   *  moveAndCollide 入口缩 dx/dy（velocity 不变——同 Collision_MoveWhileWet :93986） */
  liqFactor = 1;
  // ---- 联机傀儡标记（v3 实体同步）：快照驱动实体，本地不跑 AI/命中判定 ----
  netPuppet = false;
  /** 联机实体号（拥有者 slot 高 8 位 + 本地 id 低 24 位；见 net/entitySyncHooks） */
  netId = 0;
  // ---- P3.2 傀儡插值缓冲（15Hz 快照 × 60TPS 渲染的平滑桥）----
  /** 最新权威快照位（NPC 接触判定用；弹幕侧判定用渲染位——见 Game 两处接触注释） */
  netAx = 0; netAy = 0;
  /** 插值起点（快照到达时的渲染位）与进度（1=已到目标，纯外推） */
  netIx = 0; netIy = 0; netIt = 1;
  private netSnapIvt = 4;

  abstract fixedUpdate(dt: number, game: GameHooks): void;
  abstract draw(r: Renderer, cam: Camera): void;

  /** 快照到达（Game.netApplyNpcSnaps / netApplyProjSnaps 调用）：设插值目标。
   *  从当前渲染位连续出发（中途到包不跳变）；intervalTicks = 快照周期（15Hz=4 tick） */
  netSnapTo(x: number, y: number, intervalTicks = 4) {
    this.netIx = this.x; this.netIy = this.y;
    this.netAx = x; this.netAy = y;
    this.netIt = 0;
    this.netSnapIvt = Math.max(1, intervalTicks);
  }

  /** 傀儡每 tick 推进：未到目标走 smoothstep 插值（一个快照周期到达），到后纯速度外推 */
  netPuppetStep() {
    if (this.netIt < 1) {
      this.netIt = Math.min(1, this.netIt + 1 / this.netSnapIvt);
      const t = this.netIt * this.netIt * (3 - 2 * this.netIt); // smoothstep
      this.x = this.netIx + (this.netAx - this.netIx) * t;
      this.y = this.netIy + (this.netAy - this.netIy) * t;
      return;
    }
    this.x += this.vx;
    this.y += this.vy;
  }

  get cx() { return this.x + this.w / 2; }
  get cy() { return this.y + this.h / 2; }
  aabbOverlaps(o: Entity): boolean {
    return this.x < o.x + o.w && this.x + this.w > o.x && this.y < o.y + o.h && this.y + this.h > o.y;
  }

```

  }

  /** 按原版 NPC id 出生（小动物入微光 NPC.GetShimmered→Transform、WorldItem 放生
   *  ReleaseNPC 的落点）。联机访客拒绝——转化权威在房主（同 spawnEnemy 门禁）。
   *  入 critters 桶：spawnCritter 的 spawnVanilla 同语义（原版小动物表全量走桶） */
  spawnNpcByVanilla(id: number, x: number, y: number): Enemy | null {
    if (this.net && !this.net.policy.isHost) return null;
    // 城镇史莱姆族（670/678-684 townNPC=true）→ TownNPC 落 npcs 桶（WorldItem 681 微光链等）
    const townKey = Object.entries(TOWN_NPC_IDS).find(([, v]) => v.id === id)?.[0];
    if (townKey && id >= 670 && id <= 684) {
      const tn = new TownNPC(townKey, x, y);
      this.entities.add(tn, 'npcs');
      return tn as unknown as Enemy;
    }
    const e = Enemy.fromVanilla(id, x, y);
    if (!e) return null;
    e.id = this.entities.nextId++;
    this.entities.add(e, 'critters');
    return e;
  }

```
export class EntityManager {
  nextId = 1;
  enemies: Entity[] = [];
  drops: Entity[] = [];
  npcs: Entity[] = [];
  projectiles: Entity[] = [];
  props: Entity[] = [];   // 场景物件（墓碑等不可拾取物理实体）
  critters: Entity[] = []; // 小动物（无害被动生物）

  add(e: Entity, bucket: 'enemies' | 'drops' | 'npcs' | 'projectiles' | 'props' | 'critters') {
    e.id = this.nextId++;
    this[bucket].push(e);
  }

  update(dt: number, game: GameHooks) {
    // 就地压缩替代 6×filter(2026-08 审计 G9:每 tick 6 个新数组,60Hz 恒定分配)
    for (const list of [this.enemies, this.drops, this.npcs, this.projectiles, this.props, this.critters]) {
      for (const e of list) e.fixedUpdate(dt, game);
      compact(list);
    }
  }

  clear() {
    this.enemies.length = 0;
    this.drops.length = 0;
    this.npcs.length = 0;
    this.projectiles.length = 0;
    this.props.length = 0;
    this.critters.length = 0;
  }

  all(): Entity[] {
    return [...this.enemies, ...this.drops, ...this.npcs, ...this.projectiles, ...this.props, ...this.critters];
  }
}
